subject: Inside Samsung’s deal spree
notes: Lead essay on Samsung's European investing (nine startups backed in 2026, collectively raising €4.5bn) is a general remark with no specific event; only the Mistral Series D it cites is extracted, as background.

stories.headline: Mistral's €3bn Series D, led by Samsung, cited as context in a piece on Samsung's European investing
stories.quote: More strikingly, it's started leading some of the continent's biggest funding rounds, including French AI champion Mistral's €3bn Series D.

stories.headline: Mosaico raises €7.5m seed for managing sensor data used to develop AI-powered robots
stories.quote: Italian startup Mosaico raised €7.5m in seed funding to help companies manage the vast amounts of sensor data needed to develop AI-powered robots.
stories.description: Helps companies manage sensor data needed to develop AI-powered robots

stories.headline: Well raises $4m pre-seed for an AI assistant for small businesses
stories.quote: France-based Well, which builds an AI assistant that handles email triage, meeting prep, invoicing and payment reminders for small businesses, raised $4m in pre-seed funding.
stories.description: AI assistant for small-business email triage, meeting prep, invoicing, payment reminders

stories.headline: Starling founder Anne Boden is building a new digital bank for AI-agent payments
stories.quote: Starling founder Anne Boden is building a new digital bank designed to allow AI agents to make payments on behalf of customers.
stories.description: New digital bank letting AI agents make payments for customers
